title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative:
The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire and partners in the Nyamagabe, Nyaruguru and Rulindo regions of Rwanda, works towards the goal that women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing, and meaningful participation and leadership. This objective focuses on increasing women and older adolescent girls’ voice and leadership in all spheres. Activities include awareness raising on women's rights to participate in decision making processes; use of relevant behaviour change methodologies to explore issues of gender equality and social norms; and creating spaces to facilitate exchange between women leaders and women in the community at district and national level. The principal focus of this outcome is:
Women’s empowerment and participation in decision making spaces
